<awtsmoosMeluketTranslation heichel="ikar" alias="meluket_translation_en" seriesId="תמוז_meluket" postId="BH_POST_1766518919515_theRebbe_764" batchId="meluket-_D7_AA_D7_9E_D7_95_D7_96_meluket__BH_POST_1766518919515_theRebbe_764__p006">
  <section v="15">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section explains that the world as it comes into being from the name Havayah has time and space, but they are not limited or divided because their essence is the nullification of their own existence to the fact that Havayah brings them into being.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">And one can say the explanation of this, by prefacing that from the fact that they say that Havayah is He was, He is, and He will be</t>
    <t s="1">(as one),</t>
    <t s="2">that He was, He is, and He will be are the matter of time,</t>
    <t s="3">it is understood</t>
    <t s="4">that also the world, as it comes into being from the name Havayah, has within it the matter of time,</t>
    <t s="5">except that the time in this world is in a manner that the past, present, and future are as one.</t>
    <t s="6">And similarly regarding place, that also the world as it comes into being from the name Havayah has within it the matter of place, except that the six directions of place are as one.</t>
    <t s="7">And based on this, one can say</t>
    <t s="8">that the reason for this, that the time and place of the world as it comes into being from the name Havayah are not in limitation and division</t>
    <t s="9">(even though also the world as it comes into being from the name Havayah is incomparable to the source that brings it into being),</t>
    <t s="10">is because of the nullification within it.</t>
    <t s="11">For since the essence of the past, present, and future</t>
    <t s="12">(and likewise the essence of the six directions)</t>
    <t s="13">is not their own existence, but rather that Havayah brings them into being,</t>
    <t s="14">therefore they do not contradict one another and they are as one.</t>
  </section>
  <section v="16">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section explains that the place of the Holy of Holies, which was in division from the name Elokim, had the revelation of the name Havayah in it, constituting the unification of Havayah and Elokim.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">And based on this, it must be said</t>
    <t s="1">that what is explained in many places, that the place of the Holy of Holies is from the name Elokim</t>
    <t s="2">(even though this place was also above the category of place),</t>
    <t s="3">is</t>
    <t s="4">that the place of the Holy of Holies</t>
    <t s="5">(twenty cubits by twenty cubits)</t>
    <t s="6">was in a manner of division,</t>
    <t s="7">that each cubit is in a different place,</t>
    <t s="8">and the division of place is from the name Elokim.</t>
    <t s="9">And this is that the place of the Ark is not from the measurement—this is the matter of the unification of Havayah and Elokim,</t>
    <t s="10">that the limitation and division of the place of the Ark is from the aspect of Elokim,</t>
    <t s="11">and that it was not from the measurement is from the aspect of the revelation of the name Havayah that shone in revelation in the place that came into being from the name Elokim,</t>
    <t s="12">the unification of Havayah and Elokim.</t>
  </section>
  <section v="17">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section explains that the concealment of the name Elokim is only relative to the creations, not to the name Havayah, so even after the name Havayah clothes itself in the name Elokim, the existence does not conceal from Him and the revelation of Havayah shines within it.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">7)</t>
    <t s="1">And one must understand,</t>
    <t s="2">that this, that from the aspect of the name Elokim comes the division of place and time, is because time and place as they come into being from the name Elokim are existence,</t>
    <t s="3">for when it is felt in the six directions of place and in the past, present, and future of time that their essence is that Elokus brings them into being, they are all as one</t>
    <t s="4">(as in the above section 6),</t>
    <t s="5">so how is it possible that in the place of the Ark</t>
    <t s="6">(a place that is in division,</t>
    <t s="7">which indicates that it is existence)</t>
    <t s="8">there should be a revelation of the name Havayah</t>
    <t s="9">(not from the measurement)?</t>
    <t s="10">And the point of the explanation of this</t>
    <t s="11">is that the contraction and concealment of the name Elokim is only relative to the creations,</t>
    <t s="12">but relative to the name Havayah it does not conceal at all.</t>
    <t s="13">Therefore,</t>
    <t s="14">even after the clothing of the name Havayah in the name Elokim, through which the world becomes existence,</t>
    <t s="15">nevertheless,</t>
    <t s="16">the existence does not conceal relative to Him,</t>
    <t s="17">and even within the existence</t>
    <t s="18">(which was made through the concealment of the name Elokim)</t>
    <t s="19">through which the division of place and time is made, the revelation of the name Havayah shines,</t>
    <t s="20">whose essence is that the world is that Havayah brings it into being.</t>
    <t s="21">And as is known the parable of a master and a student,</t>
    <t s="22">that when the student is incomparable to the master,</t>
    <t s="23">the master must conceal his essential intellect and leave only the externality,</t>
    <t s="24">and even the externality he must limit and conceal in garments and explanations and parables.</t>
    <t s="25">That the contraction and concealment is only relative to the student and not relative to the master.</t>
    <t s="26">For the master sees his essential intellect even within the externality and even within the garments and the parables.</t>
  </section>
</awtsmoosMeluketTranslation>
